import hashlib,json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'sdk-rs/target/binance-account-validation'
env=os.environ.copy();env['SAFE_CEX_TYPESCRIPT_PATH']='/Users/sam/cs/tealstreet-next/node_modules/typescript'
sha=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
results={'sha':sha,'runs':[],'restored':{}}
base=['cargo','test','--manifest-path','sdk-rs/Cargo.toml','-p','safe-cex-venue-binance','--test','account_validation','--jobs','2']
def save():(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
def run(label,args,assertion=None):
 p=subprocess.run(args,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
 (out/(label+'.log')).write_text(p.stdout)
 compiled='Finished `test` profile' in p.stdout
 accepted=(p.returncode==101 and compiled and assertion in p.stdout and 'test result: FAILED. 0 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored' in p.stdout) if assertion else (p.returncode==0 and compiled and 'test result: ok. 4 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored' in p.stdout)
 entry={'label':label,'command':args,'exit':p.returncode,'compiled':compiled,'assertion':assertion,'accepted':accepted,'log_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.stdout.encode()).hexdigest()}
 if assertion:
  lines=p.stdout.splitlines();i=next((i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if assertion in l),None)
  if i is not None:entry['assertion_excerpt']=lines[i:i+3]
 results['runs'].append(entry);save();print(json.dumps(entry),flush=True)
 if not accepted:raise RuntimeError('FINDING: '+label+' failed required discrimination; see logged callsite')
path=root/'sdk-rs/safe-cex-venue-binance/src/account_validation.rs';original=path.read_bytes()
assert original==subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'{sha}:{path.relative_to(root)}'])
try:
 run('baseline',base+['--','--include-ignored'])
 for family,client,endpoint,target in [('binance','Primary','/fapi/v3/account','futures_validation_matches_source'),('binancepm','Primary','/papi/v1/account','pm_validation_matches_source'),('binancespot','Spot','/api/v3/account','spot_validation_matches_source')]:
  token=f'get(AccountValidationClient::{client}, "{endpoint}")'.encode()
  assert original.count(token)==1,(family,original.count(token))
  try:
   path.write_bytes(original.replace(token,token.replace(endpoint.encode(),(endpoint+'-wrong').encode())))
   run(family+'-wrong-primary-path',base+[target,'--','--ignored','--exact'],'VALIDATION native endpoint '+family+' case 0')
  finally:path.write_bytes(original)
finally:
 results['restored'][str(path.relative_to(root))]=path.read_bytes()==original;save()
 assert all(results['restored'].values())
run('final-restore',base+['--','--include-ignored'])
